risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with detailed year-over-year changes in net interest income, loan losses, allowances, and nonperforming loans. Risk is primarily tied to COVID-19 economic uncertainty, potential deterioration in credit quality, and management judgment in determining loan-loss allowances. The tone is balanced and factual, though some allowance adequacy and nonperforming-loan language is conditional and partially boilerplate.
